items.text: Make printhybrid.com/review a plain link to Google reviews
items.summary: Right now /review only shows the Google button after someone picks 5 stars. That's review gating, which Google's policy bans and can get reviews removed. Reviews are flat at Google 5.0 with 27, Facebook 0, Yelp 0. Printflow Coder would make /review go straight to the Google review link, through the normal review gate.

items.text: Let CFO ask the bookkeeper her rate and hours
items.summary: Third week carried. QuickBooks shows LNB at −$102,549.59, unchanged since 11/20, and Sapphire hasn't moved since 10/28. items.text: Drop the DTF downtime log for a daily Quatro care check in PrintFlow
